messages:
marta: uploaded a new compact "pebble" layout for version history in Figma — frame: Repo > Pebble Timeline. Goal: compress vertical space on repo pages while keeping canary, A/B splits, and rollback discoverable. link: https://figma.com/file/pebble123 :sparkles:
kevin: nice direction. small accessibility flag: the knob-based percentage control needs keyboard increment arrows and visible tick marks. also add `aria-valuemin`/`aria-valuemax`/`aria-valuenow` and a visually-hidden label for SRs.
olivia: agree on the SR label. also UX copy thought: current primary action says "Rollback" in the overflow menu — feels abrupt. propose changing to "Revert to previous release" and in the confirmation modal show a short, plain-language impact line. e.g.

```
Title: Revert to release v2.3.0
Body: This will redirect new traffic to v2.3.0. Ongoing requests may be interrupted. Undo available for 5 minutes.
Buttons: Cancel / Revert to v2.3.0
```

sam: +1 on softer phrasing. also visual note: canary vs stable is only distinguished by hue (teal vs indigo). for color-impaired users add a tiny glyph (dot pattern / stripe) and an explicit 1-letter label in the DOM (visually hidden offscreen for SRs but visible on hover). maybe use "C" and "S" badges as well.
marta: love the glyph idea. thinking small patterned ring around pebbles for canaries. also want a subtle delta icon when config/env differs between versions — clicking expands an inline diff panel. keeps timeline condensed but surfaces breaking changes.
kevin: inline diff should be collapsed by default. when opened, ensure keyboard focus moves into the panel (use `aria-expanded` on the row and `aria-labelledby` on the panel). Esc should close and return focus to the triggering row. avoid any focus trap that blocks timeline arrow navigation.
olivia: copy suggestion for the diff CTA: "View changes (config + env)" — concise and explicit. Also: timeline scrubber needs an ARIA live announcement like: "Selected: v2.3.0, deployed 14h ago, canary 15%" when the selection changes.
sam: contrast check: the percent badge over the heatmap is failing AA in dark theme — add a semi-opaque backing or flip to outline+text on dark mode. alternative: show percentage as plain text beside the pebble when theres limited contrast.
design-bot: Accessibility checklist: keyboard focus order, ARIA live region for selection updates, color contrast >= 4.5:1 for critical text, descriptive labels for icons, visible focus styles.
marta: action list: 1) add ticks + keyboard support to percent control (kevin) 2) change menu CTA + modal copy to safer wording + add undo microcopy (olivia) 3) pattern/glyph + C/S badges for pebbles (sam) 4) prototype collapsed inline diff + focus behavior (marta). i'll drop v2 frames by EOD and tag you.
kevin: tiny copy tweak for modal body: prefer "may be interrupted" over "may interrupt" — slightly better tone.
olivia: ok to include a muted "Undo available for 5 minutes" line beneath the primary button? keeps expectations clear.
marta: will add that. thanks everyone — will ping when v2 is up. :raised_hands:
